background.text: What D5 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: If a Property Owner initiates the deletion process for a Property that is not associated with their User Account, the Platform must prevent the logical removal of the Property record.

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner initiates property deletion, THE Platform SHALL prompt for confirmation before proceeding
rules.reading: When a property owner initiates the deletion of a property, the platform must display a confirmation prompt before proceeding with the deletion.

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner confirms deletion, THE Platform SHALL remove the Property record from the Platform
rules.reading: When a Property Owner confirms the deletion of a property, the platform must remove the property record from the platform.

probes.reading: The platform removes the property record only if the property owner confirms the deletion, implying that confirmation is a necessary condition for removal.
The platform removes the property record if and only if the property owner confirms the deletion, establishing a strict equivalence between confirmation and removal.

rules.text: WHEN a Property is deleted, THE Platform SHALL display a confirmation message and redirect to the properties list
rules.reading: If a Property has been successfully deleted, the Platform must display a confirmation message and redirect the user to the properties list.

probes.reading: The Platform displays a confirmation message and redirects to the properties list only if the Property has been successfully deleted.

rules.text: THE Platform SHALL implement soft deletion to retain Property records in the database for audit purposes while hiding them from the user interface
rules.reading: When a property deletion is successfully completed, the property record must be retained in the database and hidden from the user interface.

alternative.reading: The Platform must implement a mechanism where property records are retained in the database while being hidden from the user interface.

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner attempts to delete a Property that does not belong to their User Account, THE Platform SHALL deny the deletion and display an authorization error message
rules.reading: If a Property Owner initiates a deletion process for a Property that is not owned by their User Account, the Platform must deny the request and display an authorization error message.
